items.difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies property (B) for an integral morphism of schemes (statement lines 6025-6029, with property (B) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof reduces to the affine case using locality of the assertion and integrality of the morphism (proof lines 6031-6040) and then constructs the required etale covering of the base with the associated disjoint union decompositions (proof lines 6040-6053). The non-formal content is the affine construction, in which integrality replaces finiteness. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one construction.
